This carve-out never applies to the categories below; an automated or bulk message stays 'no' however the thread is marked.

Reply 'no' for ALL of the following, even if they contain a call to action, an interesting opportunity, or a deadline:
- Newsletters, Substack posts, blog digests (even ones soliciting pitches or submissions)
- Marketing, promotional, sales, or fundraising emails
- Automated notifications, alerts, confirmations, and digests
- Anything from no-reply, noreply, donotreply, jobalerts, notifications, marketing, or similar senders
- Calendar invites without explicit personal questions directed at the recipient
- Receipts, invoices, shipping updates, package notifications, order confirmations
- Mass-mailed announcements, event invitations, conference CFPs
- Job alerts and recruitment broadcasts (even from real recruiters using mass tools)
- Security alerts, account notifications, system messages
- Bulk emails identifiable by 'List-Unsubscribe' style cues, generic greetings, or 'view in browser' links

When unsure, prefer 'no'. False positives create draft noise; missed emails are recoverable via the daily summary.
